prompt:
Use the table in the image. It shows a spreadsheet-style table with one Name column, several numeric columns, full grid lines, and a shaded header row. Determine which selected row wins under the requested target-column extremum after applying the filter condition. Among the rows with values in Score greater than 11, which row has the highest value in the Rank column?
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence requirement: set "evidence" to an array containing the ordered supporting cell pairs [filter cell, target cell] for each selected row in top-to-bottom row order.
Answer format: set "answer" to the exact row-name string from the filtered rows.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[260,180,372,236],[374,180,486,236],[260,236,372,292],[374,236,486,292]],"answer":"Ava"}
